name: Gate & rules help
description: The gate plugin's Help mode entries (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Gate & rules
entries.text: The rules a PR must pass before it lands, the auto-lander that lands it, and the history of every change to either. Same calls as `axf gate …`, the gate_* and lander_* MCP tools and voice.

entries.title: Gate settings
entries.text: This plugin's settings under Settings → Plugins: how often the open tab refreshes, how much History keeps, and which tab it opens on.

entries.title: Rules
entries.text: Every gate rule with its on/off switch, severity and settings.

entries.title: Auto-lander
entries.text: The Merge queue switch, the lander's status, the PRs waiting to land and its last runs.

entries.title: History
entries.text: Every rule change and lander action: who, when, before and after.

entries.title: Rule
entries.text: The rule's name; with two lines a row, what it checks underneath. Tap the row to open its settings.

entries.title: Checks
entries.text: What the rule looks at: CI, tests, theme, controls, UI Review, a clash with main, or a policy.

entries.title: Severity
entries.text: Block: the PR waits until it passes. Warn: it lands and History notes it. Info: only recorded.

entries.title: Run by
entries.text: Who evaluates the rule: the console now, axf-molly once that container owns the gate. A rule is never run by both.

entries.title: On
entries.text: Switches the rule on or off at once. Off rules are skipped for every PR.

entries.title: PR
entries.text: The pull request number to check, for example 705.

entries.title: Check a PR
entries.text: Shows whether that PR can land, rule by rule, from what the lander knows. It changes nothing.

entries.title: Reset to defaults
entries.text: Puts every gate rule back to its default. It asks first; History keeps what was there.

entries.title: Save
entries.text: Saves the changed fields. The change is written to History.

entries.title: Merge queue
entries.text: On: ready PRs go through the stacked merge queue and the one-at-a-time lander is off. Off (the default): the auto-lander lands each finished build one at a time, main merged in first. Takes effect at once.

entries.title: Land now
entries.text: Puts the selected PR at the head of the line in the current mode. It asks first and still has to pass every rule; nothing is merged directly.

entries.title: Land next
entries.text: Puts this PR at the head of the line. It asks first and still has to pass every rule.

entries.title: Why pause
entries.text: Optional: why you pause the lander. It shows on the status card, in History and in the alert.

entries.title: Pause
entries.text: Stops the lander from starting anything new; what is landing now finishes. Resume carries on.

entries.title: Resume
entries.text: Starts the lander again in its current mode.

entries.title: Show
entries.text: Which History entries to list: all, rule changes, or lander actions.

entries.title: Held by
entries.text: The gate rule that keeps this PR from landing.

entries.title: Why
entries.text: Why the PR waits, in plain words.

entries.title: Result
entries.text: How the run ended: landed, landing, idle, skipped or error.

entries.title: Refresh every (seconds)
entries.text: How often the open Gate & rules tab asks the lander again (5 to 600).

entries.title: History size (entries kept)
entries.text: How many History entries are kept; the oldest go first (50 to 20000).

entries.title: Tab it opens on
entries.text: The tab Gate & rules opens on, unless you were on another one last time.

steps.say: Rules: what every PR must pass before it lands. Switch a rule off or change its severity here.
Auto-lander: the Merge queue switch, what is landing and what waits, and why.
History: every change and lander action, with before and after.
